newsitem.title: CHINA: AWT WORLD TO RAISE HK$87 MLN IN SHR ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: AWT WORLD TO RAISE HK$87 MLN IN SHR ISSUE.

text.p: AWT World Transport Holdings Ltd said in a statement on Friday it had agreed to place 98 million new shares at HK$0.91 per share with independent private investors, raising net proceeds of HK$87 million.

AWT said it intended to use about HK$25 million of the proceeds to expand its freight forwarding business, about HK$35 million to expand its real estate agency network and about HK$15 million to repay short-term bank borrowings.
The balance would be used for general working capital.
The new shares represent about 19.25 percent of the company's existing share capital and about 16.14 percent of its enlarged issued share capital.
AWT shares closed at HK$1.11 on Thursday.
